contract.title: Implement and test slugify helper
contract.acceptance_criterion: slugify returns a lowercase URL-safe slug, handles empty input, and rejects non-string input with TypeError.
contract.deterministic_validity_check: node --input-type=module -e "import { slugify } from './src/slugify.js'; if (slugify('Hello, World!') !== 'hello-world' || slugify('') !== '') throw new Error('slugify behavior failed'); try { slugify(1); throw new Error('missing TypeError') } catch (error) { if (!(error instanceof TypeError)) throw error }"
patch_requirements: Create src/slugify.js with no imports from other helpers.
Create test/slugify.test.js covering normal, empty, and non-string TypeError cases.

contract.title: Implement and test truncate helper
contract.acceptance_criterion: truncate returns unchanged strings at or below max length, returns a string of exactly max characters including an ellipsis when truncating, handles empty input, and rejects non-string input with TypeError.
contract.deterministic_validity_check: node --input-type=module -e "import { truncate } from './src/truncate.js'; if (truncate('hello', 5) !== 'hello' || truncate('hello', 4) !== 'h...' || truncate('hello', 4).length !== 4 || truncate('', 1) !== '') throw new Error('truncate boundary behavior failed'); try { truncate(1, 4); throw new Error('missing TypeError') } catch (error) { if (!(error instanceof TypeError)) throw error }"
patch_requirements: Create src/truncate.js with no imports from other helpers.
Create test/truncate.test.js covering unchanged, truncated, exact-boundary, empty, and non-string TypeError cases.

contract.title: Implement and test wordCount helper
contract.acceptance_criterion: wordCount returns the number of whitespace-separated words, returns zero for empty or whitespace-only input, and rejects non-string input with TypeError.
contract.deterministic_validity_check: node --input-type=module -e "import { wordCount } from './src/wordCount.js'; if (wordCount('one two three') !== 3 || wordCount('  one\ttwo\nthree  ') !== 3 || wordCount('   ') !== 0 || wordCount('') !== 0) throw new Error('wordCount behavior failed'); try { wordCount(null); throw new Error('missing TypeError') } catch (error) { if (!(error instanceof TypeError)) throw error }"
patch_requirements: Create src/wordCount.js with no imports from other helpers.
Create test/wordCount.test.js covering normal, whitespace-separated, empty, whitespace-only, and non-string TypeError cases.
